question: Do the two portable modules — producer ProducerScoreModel -> plan_producer_command and orderer OrdererScoreModel -> allocate_suborders — COEXIST in one env and hold value when run jointly (the full portable stack), with no feasibility failure and no relabel mismatch?
plan: PRODUCT_AGNOSTIC.md combined ladder C1 (portable stack smoke)

method.stack: producer = scorer/planner (EXP-0013 v2 gate-head checkpoint); orderer = scorer/allocator (EXP-0012 checkpoint). No re-train: both distilled checkpoints reused unchanged.
method.env: TokenomicsAECEnv(entity_producer_obs=True, product_stream_ordering=True, corrected_stream_k=True) — the entity producer view (v2) and the corrected v4 product-stream ordering are orthogonal flags; this is the first env that turns both on at once.
method.deploy: scorer_producing_policy -> producing_entity_planner_from_scorer -> plan_producer_command (planner owns producer feasibility) AND scorer_ordering_policy -> decode_ordering -> allocate_suborders (allocator owns orderer eligibility + conservation). Each learned policy reads its own white-box view off env.system.
method.bar: deterministic entity_planner + proportional on the SAME joint env (apples-to-apples).
method.train_topologies: n/a (reused checkpoints; producer distilled on scale seeds 0-5 depth 3, orderer on seeds 0-5 depth 3)
method.held_out: build_scale_config seeds 6-9, depth 3 (P=12) — train-size topology family, unseen seeds

metric: Per held-out seed: joint-stack mean consumer_completed_units / (entity_planner+proportional) units, both death rates (value); AND per seed a capacity-type-relabel gate = the joint episode is byte-identical under a pure capacity rename (no relabel mismatch). Contract feasibility/conservation proven in tests/test_joint_stack.py.
pass: Joint stack loads + runs both portable modules in one env with no feasibility failure (test) AND mean value ratio vs entity_planner+proportional >= ~1.0 with joint death <= bar death AND the relabel gate is byte-identical on every seed (test + driver).
notes: Local eval only (HARD RULE: this is evaluation of existing checkpoints, no training). C1 is the gateway to the combined ladder (C2 size transfer, C3 out-of-family). The value lift over the deterministic bar is orderer-driven (EXP-0012 orderer beats proportional ~1.28x at depth 3; the producer scorer ties entity_planner per EXP-0013), so the joint ratio sits below the orderer-alone number because the bar pairs the strong entity_planner producer. Out-of-family recipe transfer (P2/O3 open axis) is NOT covered here.
